albedo_source: LOLA normal albedo LDAM_50S_1000M_FLOAT (imbrium.mit.edu/DATA/LOLA_GDR/POLAR/FLOAT_IMG) 1 km/px, + small DEM-derived AO/grain detail
source: LOLA LDEM_75S_240M (PGDA/PDS), polar stereographic south, lon0=0
encoding: lossless WebP (RGB), v=R*256+G (16-bit split, quantised to multiples of 4 = 0.76 m steps to compress better; DEM is 0.5 m/LSB, real vertical accuracy ~1 m), h=h_min+v/65535*(h_max-h_min), heights rel. 1737.4 km sphere
projection: x=2R tan(pi/4+lat/2) sin(lon), y=2R tan(pi/4+lat/2) cos(lon); image col=x, row=-y (row grows away from lon 0)
scene_frame: pole scene units km: X=x_ps, Z=-y_ps, Y=up; ME->scene: (X,Y,Z)=(y_ME,-z_ME,-x_ME)
